python -c "
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Read data (formulas read as NaN via pandas, so read raw inputs)
wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sales Data']

print('Verifying formulas and computing expected margins...')
errors = 0
for r in range(2, 10):
    units = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    price = ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value
    cost  = ws.cell(row=r, column=6).value
    rev   = units * price
    prof  = rev - units * cost
    margin = prof / rev
    h = ws.cell(row=r, column=8)
    print(f'Row {r}: {ws.cell(row=r,column=1).value} {ws.cell(row=r,column=2).value} | H formula: {h.value} | expected margin: {margin:.3%}')
    assert h.value == f'=G{r}/E{r}', f'bad formula {h.value}'
    assert ws.cell(row=r, column=5).value == f'=C{r}*D{r}'
    assert ws.cell(row=r, column=7).value == f'=E{r}-C{r}*F{r}'
print('TOTAL row H10:', ws['H10'].value, '| expected:', (sum(ws.cell(row=r,column=3).value*ws.cell(row=r,column=4).value for r in range(2,10)) - sum(ws.cell(row=r,column=3).value*ws.cell(row=r,column=6).value for r in range(2,10))) / sum(ws.cell(row=r,column=3).value*ws.cell(row=r,column=4).value for r in range(2,10)))

# Scan all cells for error strings
errs = []
for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for c in row:
        if isinstance(c.value, str) and c.value.startswith('#'):
            errs.append((c.coordinate, c.value))
print('Formula errors found:', errs if errs else 'NONE')
print('H column formats:', [ws.cell(row=r, column=8).number_format for r in range(2, 11)])
print('Header H1:', ws['H1'].value, '| bold:', ws['H1'].font.bold, '| fill:', ws['H1'].fill.fgColor.rgb)
"
